scope: All ten full-frame contact-sheet views, annotation-overlay presentation and retained demonstration background
engineering_observations: All ten full-frame tiles have readable captions. Gold direct amodal rectangles appear only on positives.
The owned target appears as a dark tapered silhouette, with tail/flukes upper-left and nose lower-right, inside the five positive rectangles. It becomes a small mark with limited detail at 3–4 cm/px.

The corresponding central owned form and rectangle are absent from negatives. Tight negative frames are largely uniform blue water; a large unrelated animal enters the lower/right edge of wider views and remains unlabelled.
Background animals occupy corresponding paired locations. The clipped tail at 1 cm/px has some row shading difference; its cause is not established and bitwise/photometric equivalence is not claimed.

Shallow_swim/rootdepth0.5m are retained-state metadata on a static upright mesh proxy. Contact-sheet observations do not certify biological pose, water optics or exact visible/refracted outlines; machine visibility stays unknown.
